info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Kestrel Laptop Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API provides the capability to add detailed specifications for Kestrel laptops to the product catalog. It is crucial for businesses looking to enhance their inventory with comprehensive product information, such as technical specifications and features. Typical users include inventory managers and e-commerce platforms that require robust catalog data to improve customer experiences. This API streamlines the process of updating laptop details, ensuring that product information is accurate and up-to-date.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed records for Kestrel laptops, enabling better tracking and management of laptop specifications and features.
